description: This file contains unit tests for the CreditAllocationsValidator class in the Fineract project, specifically testing validation logic for credit allocation rules in loan products.

classes.name: CreditAllocationsValidatorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for CreditAllocationsValidator, validating various scenarios including correct validation, duplicate rules, invalid order, and invalid transaction type.

methods.name: testCreditAllocationsHasNoError
methods.description: Tests that valid credit allocations pass without errors.

methods.name: testCreditAllocationsValidationThrowsErrorWhenLessElement
methods.description: Ensures validation throws an error when the number of credit allocation rules is less than expected.

methods.name: testCreditAllocationsValidationThrowsErrorWhenWithDuplicate
methods.description: Ensures validation throws an error if duplicate credit allocation rules are present.

methods.name: testCreditAllocationsValidationThrowsErrorWhenOrderIsNotInRange
methods.description: Checks that validation detects invalid order values outside the 1-4 range.

methods.name: testValidateThrowsErrorWhenPaymentAllocationProvidedWithOtherStrategy
methods.description: Verifies error is thrown when credit allocation is provided with a non-advanced payment strategy.

methods.name: testValidateThrowsErrorWhenTransactionTypeEmpty
methods.description: Checks that an error occurs if the transaction type is null.

methods.name: testValidateNoError
methods.description: Verifies that valid credit allocation rules pass validation without errors.

methods.name: testValidateCreditAllocationIsOptional
methods.description: Checks that an empty list of credit allocations is considered valid.

methods.name: testValidateThrowsErrorWhenDuplicate
methods.description: Ensures that duplicate transaction types in credit allocations trigger an error.

methods.name: createCreditAllocationTypeList
methods.description: Generates a list of pairs representing credit allocation orders and types for testing.

methods.name: createLoanProductCreditAllocationRule1
methods.description: Creates a sample LoanProductCreditAllocationRule with a CHARGEBACK transaction type and all allocation types.

methods.name: assertPlatformValidationException
methods.description: Asserts that a validation exception with specific message and code is thrown.

methods.name: assertPlatformException
methods.description: Checks that the thrown exception contains the expected message and code.
